title: Mullvad browser (LinuxServer.io)
tagline: The Mullvad Browser is a privacy-focused web browser developed in a collaboration between Mullvad Vpn and the Tor Project. It’s designed to minimise tracking and fingerprinting. You could say it’s a Tor Browser to use without the Tor Network. Instead, you can use it with a trustworthy Vpn.
